description: Land Acquisition - Dodamkumbra, Thumpane D/S Division, Kandy District (Section 07)
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed information about a specific land parcel (location, survey details, extent) being acquired for public purpose, includes notice requirements for interested parties, and deals with compensation claims. This fits perfectly within Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it focuses on land acquisition and property matters without any government personnel changes or structural modifications.
